screens.penny: Hi, {name}! Let's help Nadia run a lemonade stand.

screens.title: Selling something

cards.caption: First you make something people would like.
Then you pick a price. People pay it.

screens.penny: Make it, price it, sell it, {name}.

screens.prompt: Each cup costs Nadia 1 coin to make. What price should she pick?
screens.pennyHint: She wants a little extra for her work, {name}.
screens.rightMessage: Yes, {name}! 2 coins pays for the lemon and for her work.
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! At 1 coin she only gets the lemon money back.

screens.story: It turns cold. Nobody wants Nadia's icy lemonade today.
screens.pennyHint: Think about what people want on a cold day, {name}.

options.label: Sell something warm instead
options.outcome: Nadia sells warm cocoa. People line up at her stand!

options.label: Wait in the cold all day
options.outcome: Nadia waits and waits. Still nobody buys cold lemonade.

options.label: Put the price up to 20 coins
options.outcome: That is a big price for icy lemonade. Still nobody buys.

screens.rightMessage: Yes, {name}! People buy what they want. Nadia listened and changed.
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! On a cold day people want a warm drink.

screens.prompt: Nadia sold 3 cups at 2 coins each. Tap 6 coins for her bag.
screens.rightMessage: 6 coins, {name}! Three cups at 2 coins each makes 6.
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! Count 2 coins for each of the 3 cups.

screens.prompt: Nadia squeezed the lemons and sold the cups. Who earned the coins?
screens.pennyHint: Think about who did the work, {name}.
screens.rightMessage: Yes, {name}! Nadia made it, sold it and earned it.
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! Nadia did the work, so Nadia earned the coins.
screens.retryIntro: One more look, {name}. Who did the work?

screens.title: Lesson done, {name}!
screens.message: Nadia made something people wanted. That's earning.
